title: Red Teaming Multimodal Language Models: Evaluating Harm Across Prompt Modalities and Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focused on harm categories such as illegal activity, disinformation, and unethical behavior.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it was not a focus of the study.
